I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/php-src`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
Stack-use-after-return in PHP's unserialization code (php_var_unserialize_internal / process_nested_data in ext/standard/var_unserializer.re). During deserialization of crafted input, zval_get_type ends up reading a zval that refers to stack memory which has gone out of scope, causing reads of invalid stack memory and leading to crashes or other undefined behavior during unserialize.
